item.title: IBM Ships Agentic Coding Assistant Directly Into IBM i Systems Via VS Code
item.summary: IBM released the IBM Bob Premium Package for i on June 24, 2026, delivering native QSYS connectivity, IBM i–specific agent skills, and agentic workflows inside VS Code — enabling developers to compile, test, and modernize RPG, COBOL, and CL code directly against IBM i systems without export loops.
